## createBearerCredential() function

Wrap a bearer secret (such as a `macts_sk_` API key) in a self-redacting `Credential`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function createBearerCredential(secret: string): Credential
```

**Returns:**

[Credential](./contracts.credential.md)

A credential that presents `secret` under the bearer scheme.

## Remarks

`String(credential)`<!-- -->, template literals, `JSON.stringify`<!-- -->, `util.inspect`<!-- -->, and `Object.keys` never expose the secret; only `reveal()` returns it. An empty secret is accepted here and rejected at verification as a missing credential, so "no credential" has one representation and one failure.
